messages.subject: Warnings don't get reported
parts:
Hello,

I just came across a very strange things (to me at least) with the
occu function:

When I run an occu function that should produce a NAN warning message
and assign the results to a variable like:

dummy <- occu(formula = ~CR_CL_3Z + Is_sizeZ + OCODES ~ RUR_1KMZ, data
= AMGOUMF)

I get:

warnings()
NULL

if on the other hand I just run the occu function:

occu(formula = ~CR_CL_3Z + Is_sizeZ + OCODES ~ RUR_1KMZ, data =
AMGOUMF)

I get:

Call:
occu(formula = ~CR_CL_3Z + Is_sizeZ + OCODES ~ RUR_1KMZ, data =
AMGOUMF)
.
.
.
AIC: 1038.55
Warning message:
In sqrt(diag(vcov(obj))) : NaNs produced

warnings()
Warning message:
In sqrt(diag(vcov(obj))) : NaNs produced


I think I should also be getting a warning message in the first case
as well and was wondering if you could help me understand why this is
not the case?

Thanks very much,
Richard S.
